confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Santiago price levels; no live menus, rates or listings were checked. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are more reliable than lodging, which varies by district and season (July is a lower-demand winter month). Cocktail (about 2x beer) and wine glass (about 1.1x beer) are derived from the beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value is taken from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, which I could not open or verify directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated to the supplied Lima, Rio de Janeiro and Buenos Aires figures: Santiago sits at or near Buenos Aires for beer, mid-range dining and hostel beds; sits between Rio and Buenos Aires for coffee and inexpensive dining; is slightly below Rio and Buenos Aires for basic hotels and close to Rio for three-star hotels; and is well above Lima overall. The city may still differ from these comparables.
